description:
intent=i013 snapshot=s02 branch=nonlinear-linear-assume status=complete
finding location=net/netfilter/xt_osf.c:220-272 confidence=high conclusion=xt_osf_match() ignores the NULL return of skb_header_pointer() into optp and dereferences *optp at xt_osf.c:262, so a non-linear TCP SYN with doff>5 whose options live in frags NULL-reads/crashes in the receive-side xt match when a matching fingerprint is loaded.
coverage_gap=No compilation, KASAN build, or reproducer was run against the read-only snapshot; both findings are source-reading hypotheses, and reachability of a non-linear skb at the xt_osf hook (GRO/SG/aggregation configuration) was argued structurally, not measured.
limitation=The xt_osf finding's concrete failure mode is a NULL-pointer read (or parse of bytes that are not there), not the seed's use-after-free, because skb_header_pointer() returns NULL rather than a stale pointer; the branch definition explicitly treats the missing-linear-guarantee invariant as equivalent.
limitation=Triggering the xt_osf NULL dereference requires an iptables rule with the xt_osf match, a loaded userspace fingerprint whose summed option length equals the attacker-chosen optsize and whose ss/ttl match, plus a non-linear (frag-backed or GRO-aggregated) SYN packet - so exploitation is conditional on administrator configuration, narrower than the seed's always-on phonet receive path.
limitation=The batadv_recv_unicast_packet finding is a pattern match whose only unguarded byte (packet_type at offset 0) lies within the 2-byte pskb_may_pull performed by batadv_batman_skb_recv, so an actual out-of-bounds read was not established; it is reported as a medium-confidence hypothesis mirroring Fact f005 for s01, and the deeper field reads were verified to be covered by batadv_check_unicast_packet's pull.
limitation=Whether received batman-adv skbs can be non-linear at batadv_batman_skb_recv depends on the hard-interface driver's SG/GRO configuration, which is deployment-dependent and was not verified per driver.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque and no git history is available, so it cannot be determined whether upstream has since fixed net/netfilter/xt_osf.c or net/batman-adv/routing.c; line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s02 as supplied.
limitation=The seed location net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by instruction and never considered as a report target; prior s02 facts (decnet dn_route/dn_nsp, mac80211 tdls/rx stale-pointer, NCSI, nfc llcp agf, lapb, atm lec) cover adjacent branches and were used only as triage context.
